description: This Java class defines an immutable command named DeleteSubject used within the Eclipse Ditto project to delete a Subject from a Policy. It includes methods for creating instances from parameters or JSON, and methods for serialization and comparison.

classes.name: DeleteSubject
classes.description: Immutable command class for deleting a Subject in a policy, with methods for JSON serialization/deserialization, and overrides for equals, hashCode, and toString.

methods.name: getLabel
methods.description: Returns the label of the policy entry whose subject is to be deleted.

methods.name: getSubjectId
methods.description: Returns the identifier of the subject to delete.

methods.name: getEntityId
methods.description: Returns the PolicyId associated with this command.

methods.name: getResourcePath
methods.description: Constructs and returns the JSON pointer path to the resource affected by this command.

methods.name: appendPayload
methods.description: Appends the command's data to the JSON payload, respecting schema version and predicate filtering.

methods.name: getCategory
methods.description: Returns the category of the command, which is DELETE.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new instance of DeleteSubject with updated DittoHeaders.

methods.name: canEqual
methods.description: Checks if another object is an instance of DeleteSubject for equality purposes.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Defines equality based on policyId, label, subjectId, and superclass properties.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Computes a hash code based on class properties.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Provides a string representation of this command instance.
